name: session-unreachable

graded_by.test: core/internal/session/unreachable_test.go — a session on a v0.1 worker is unreachable / protocol: attachable, showing what the core has, its input refused with the C2 input_refused frame
harness/rigs/unreachable.sh — a frozen v0.1 worker under the v0.2 core: its session reads unreachable / protocol, attaches, and refuses input with reason unreachable

description: unreachable (immortality §3, §6.4, §7; decision 5.38): the worker is alive but the core cannot run C3's handshake with it — locally, only a v0.1 worker under a v0.2 core (a dead local worker path is terminated / worker_lost). The session is attachable and shows what the core already has; input to it is refused with an explicit error, the C2 input_refused frame with reason unreachable, and the operator drains it. A v0.1 client treats the unknown state as not attachable, which is safe. Not detached: detached has no clients, unreachable has no data path the core reads. The core neither reads nor records its output (decision 5.38; orchestrator DEFAULT, approval page): output after the upgrade is not in its recording, and nothing there marks it.
